execution_changes_since_qualification: Only a profiler annotation around the packet loop. Model/decoder/native sources are unchanged; the entire pre-timing and timed execution is requalified on devices.
limitations: Fixed weak 9x9 model and float32/highest execution; no MCTS, training or strength improvement claim.
First timing stream extends the earlier short qualification stream; two additional streams and counterbalanced orders are prospective. This is an exploratory systems screen.
Accepted game prefixes are paired within host and mode. Distinct modes are not independent game samples.
Known-policy mode shares actual self-play draws; learned behavior k4 uses independent forecasts.
Complete packet-loop timing excludes compilation and artifact serialization; total attempt cost includes them.
Logical byte and compiler FLOP estimates are not measured link traffic or device MFU.
Average active process CPU cores include runtime threads, Python and Rust; they do not prove cache efficiency.

primary_speed_criterion.metric: Sequential slowest-host packet-loop wall time divided by joint slowest-host packet-loop wall time, at identical accepted work and exact per-host events/final states.

stopping_rule: Any execution/state mismatch, process failure, malformed artifact or budget excess prevents speed promotion. One attempt; preserve failures.
